# ADR-3237: AWS secrets: Prefer SSM Parameter Store SecureString for config 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

String parameters leave values readable.

## Decision

Apps SHOULD prefer SSM Parameter Store SecureString for config 5 (AWS-secrets-5) when values are sensitive.

## Consequences

KMS CMKs encrypt SecureString params.
